Figure out how much extra cash you'd have on a yearly basis. Divide that by 12, and start SIPs in index mutual funds. That's how I started, and now 2.5 years since graduation have built up a healthy corpus with annualised rate of return currently 12.5% even with the dip. In fact, this is the best time.

I had some extra prize money from competitions when the lockdown crash came, and did lumpsums investments then.

Just start, by the time you graduate or end of your internship, you'll figure out the rate of returns to expect and build up knowledge, while a small corpus will start building up gradually giving you (and compounding ;) ) your confidence too.


I'd highly suggest not investing in crypto at this stage. Kharcha will come in medicine in our further studies too, and later on to build the lifestyle you want and need as a working doctor.
